title: DevFest 2026 Hackathon
description:
The DevFest 2026 Hackathon is a two-day in-person competition organized by GDG Belgrade. Teams of three or four participants develop and present a project; individual applicants may be matched into teams. Working language is Serbian; presentations are in English. Age, prerequisite conference attendance, and team requirements are stated in the registration instructions.

Organizer: GDG Belgrade

Source: https://gdg.community.dev/events/details/google-gdg-belgrade-presents-devfest-2026-hackathon/

Registration: open. Applicants must be aged 18 to 26 and attend the DevFest Conference on October 9. Teams have three or four members; individuals may apply and be matched.
